summary: Donald Ward, 55, of Colorado Springs died of health complications during a hike with friends near the summit of Mt. Cameron north of Alma; Park County SAR and the Park County Coroner recovered his body from the mountain over about five hours
location: Mt. Cameron summit area, north of Alma
responding_agency: Park County SAR, Park County Coroner, Flight for Life Colorado, South Park Ambulance, North-West Fire
notes: Park County Coroner press release 8-24-20 ("died today"); Ward was a KKTV news anchor; cause pending autopsy, death not considered suspicious
